research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Anaplan is researching data driven business planning tools. Application configurator using a baseline model describes generating new applications from baseline planning models for consistent model configuration. Synchronized scrolling of multiple grids across multi-dimensional data improves exploration of complex planning grids. Systems and methods for forecasting warm start items, merging datasets, and dimensional reduction of categorical data enhance forecasting, data integration, and time series analysis.

overview_description.description: Anaplan is driving a new age of connected planning. Large and fast-growing organizations use Anaplan’s cloud platform in every business function to make better-informed plans and decisions and drive faster, more effective planning processes. Anaplan also provides support, training, and planning transformation advisory services. Anaplan is a privately held company based in San Francisco with 16 offices and over 150 expert partners worldwide.

about_short_description.short_description: Anaplan is a business planning software company that develops a cloud platform for decision-making with connected planning modeling.

product.name: Anaplan Platform
product.description: A cloud-based connected planning and scenario analysis platform that combines data integration, modeling, workflows, analytics, security, and collaboration across business functions.

product.name: Anaplan Applications
product.description: Purpose-built cloud applications for finance, sales, supply chain, retail, and workforce planning, built on the Anaplan platform for common business planning processes.

product.name: Anaplan Intelligence
product.description: An AI capability set that applies predictive, generative, and agentic AI to planning, analysis, forecasting, workflows, and decision support.

product.name: Anaplan CoModeler
product.description: An AI assistant for building, extending, and optimizing Anaplan models through conversational interactions and real-time scenario modeling.

product.name: Anaplan Intelligent Role-Based Agents
product.description: Domain-specific AI agents that answer questions, generate insights, evaluate scenarios, and support actions for finance, sales, supply chain, and workforce users.

product.name: Finance Planning Solutions
product.description: Connected planning solutions for financial planning and analysis, budgeting, forecasting, consolidation, reporting, profitability, revenue, expense, capital, and headcount planning.
